item.title: Ireland U20’s fail to get off the mark against England - Midwest Radio
item.description: England's defence of the under-20 Six Nations title is off to a winning start. They beat Ireland by 19 points to 3 at Virgin Media Park in Cork last night, with Ireland's only points coming from a Sam Wisniewski penalty.

item.title: Elective surgeries postponed at MUH due to overcrowding - Midwest Radio
item.description: Mayo University Hospital (MUH) is advising the public of long wait times in the Emergency Department (ED) as it deals with high attendances. The ED in MUH is extremely busy today with more than 300 patients having attended since Saturday morning. There are currently 17 patients on trolleys in the ED waiting admission and all escalation areas fully utilised.

item.title: Kerry too strong for Roscommon - Midwest Radio
item.description: Kerry opened their account with a big win over Roscommon in Killarney. David Clifford Gavin White and Paul Geaney all hit the back of the net in a 3-18 to 17 point win this afternoon.
